description.value: Drip Coffee Social is a community-minded independent café established in 2018, operating two Nanaimo locations with a stated focus on inclusivity and local gathering. The Dufferin Crescent location offers a full espresso and tea menu alongside food bowls, sandwiches, baked goods, and even beer, wine, and seasonal cocktails. Mobile ordering is available, making it a convenient stop for cyclists moving through the south Nanaimo corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Dufferin Crescent location of a two-location Nanaimo café (the other being at Departure Bay); the address and website URL both match OSM tags. The website provides a phone number (778-441-5200) for this location that is absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, but the menu explicitly lists gluten-free items and plant-based dishes, and mobile ordering confirms takeout capability.
